chats.answer:
The lightest laptop-attached screen extenders I found with credible weight specifications are about 1.3 lb. I'd choose the Mobile Pixels Duex Plus DS if you want a screen that stays attached and slides out, or the KOJOM if you want a larger screen for less money.

Mobile Pixels Duex Plus DS

1.3 lb · 13.3-inch · 1080p

Attaches magnetically to your laptop lid and slides out. USB-C or mini HDMI. Best fit for 13–14-inch laptops. Manufacturer-verified weight. 
Mobile Pixels

KOJOM 14-inch Screen Extender

$144.18

newegg.com

1.31 lb advertised weight, 14-inch 1080p screen. A larger, cheaper alternative, but the listing has no reviews and I couldn't independently verify its weight.

Mobile Pixels Duex Max DS

1.8 lb · 14.1-inch · 1080p

Larger slide-out alternative with manufacturer-verified weight. Still below your limit, though with less room for cables and accessories. 
Mobile Pixels

Important weight caveat: I interpreted “extender” as a screen that mounts to the laptop, not a freestanding portable monitor. The weights above are advertised device weights; I couldn't confirm total travel weight with every cable and mounting accessory included. I also can't establish that 1.3 lb is the absolute market minimum.
